# Original synthetic compatibility fixtures

`v0_1_engine_offline/` was generated by the installed v0.1.0 release wheel built
from commit `ed852eaf85f86e7ac8c2aea7a69b767765f65905`, using the repository's
`scenarios/engine_offline.json` and Python 3.12.8. It contains 41 canonical events,
with semantic SHA-256 `0d6bae00cc964c40627a39fcbbac28367fe0501061379d83cb4283ea2ec51c5c`.
The manifest and checksums are kept unchanged to exercise historical playback.
Rerun under a newer core is expected to reject the source-hash mismatch.

This small original DemoCar fixture is MIT licensed with the project. It contains
no real vehicle data, OEM profile, secrets or personal data.
